reviews.title: Like the ads
reviews.text: If your game were actually like the ads, where you had to pick between options and everything, I would genuinely play it. It would be nice if games were actually like their ads because there are so many times when I see an ad, click to play the game, and realize it's nothing like it was advertised. It just isn't as fun. I would genuinely play those ad games for hours, and I would play actual game for hours, too, if they were anything like the freaking ads!

reviews.title: Too Many Ads
reviews.text: The game is honestly good but I refuse to sit through an ad every 30 seconds and I’m *definitely* not paying $30 to remove ads. Thirty dollars is an exorbitant price to ask anyone to pay in today’s economy. I understand you have to pay your developers, but you also have to be realistic. If there were less ads, I would give this a 4 star easily.
